verdict.headline: Iran's new Hormuz demands stall the oil deal and lift crude as equities hold records
verdict.label: Weekend stalemate hardened into escalation: Iran conditions Hormuz on US war exit; WTI $0.28 from $79; Brent $0.61 from $85; CPI Wednesday August 12 is the week's gate
verdict.rationale_short: Iran's FM Araghchi stated August 8 that a deal with Oman alone will not reopen the Strait of Hormuz — Iran requires the US to end the war and provide financial compensation, conditions outside the current negotiating track. Houthi forces struck Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery (400K bbl/day) overnight; fire was extinguished without injuries or disruption. WTI at $78.72 and Brent at $84.39 sit $0.28 and $0.61 from their respective breach triggers; the 30Y held at 5.08%. Level that changes the read: WTI closes above $79 or Brent above $85 before Wednesday's CPI print (August 12, 8:30 AM ET).

trade_setups.asset: July CPI — Wednesday August 12, 8:30 AM ET
trade_setups.thesis: July CPI is the week's singular binary after Friday's NFP shock removed the wage-inflation channel. June CPI came in at +2.9% YoY headline, +3.2% core. July embeds Brent at $82-91/bbl from the June-July peak; the August pullback to $84 is not in this comp. At or below June levels (headline ≤2.9%, core ≤3.2%): 30Y path through 5.00%, September below 25%, regime clearing; rate-relief thesis confirmed. Above 3.2% headline or 3.5% core: September re-escalates toward 65%+, 30Y above 5.20%, SPX record becomes an air pocket into the Aug 20 SPCX tranche. The 30Y at 5.08% — 8bps above the formal threshold — clears on a soft print or breaches further on a hot one.
trade_setups.entry: Pre-CPI tell: 30Y action Tuesday — a drift above 5.15% before the print signals bond markets pre-pricing a hot read. DXY at 99.5 — a move above 100.50 post-CPI confirms rate re-escalation.
trade_setups.invalidation: CPI in-line (within ±0.1% of June levels) leaves September unresolved; Jackson Hole (Aug 27) then decides.
trade_setups.horizon: 2 days — Wednesday August 12 at 8:30 AM ET

trade_setups.thesis: WTI at $78.72 is $0.28 from the $79 trigger; Brent at $84.39 is $0.61 from $85. Iran's FM formally decoupled Hormuz reopening from the Oman routing deal on August 8, requiring the US to end the war and pay compensation. Houthi strikes on Saudi Aramco infrastructure continue alongside diplomacy. A single escalation event before Wednesday activates both oil triggers simultaneously (2-of-6 regime), compounding any CPI risk. A surprise US-Iran framework addressing Iran's stated conditions compresses WTI toward $70-72 and clears both indicators. The deal has failed to close three times in 2026.
trade_setups.entry: WTI $78.72 ($0.28 from breach), Brent $84.39 ($0.61 from breach). Brent above $85 on any Hormuz incident is the regime-change alert.
trade_setups.invalidation: A formally signed US-Iran deal addressing the stated conditions compresses WTI below $73 and eliminates the oil risk.

trade_setups.thesis: The 20% first tranche (911.5M shares, Aug 6-8) absorbed without cascading below $105; SPCX extended to $133.11 on Day 5 on Terafab confirmation. The Aug 20 7% tranche (~65M shares, ~$8.65B eligible) is the next supply gate. Soft CPI Wednesday → rate compression extends the absorption window → $130+ hold likely. Hot CPI → simultaneous multiple compression and supply pressure is the highest-beta downside scenario across the watchlist. October Q3 earnings (Starlink profitability, AI segment above $2.56B) is the fundamental narrative anchor for the $140+ targets.
trade_setups.entry: Absorption floor $105; Day 5 hold level $128+. Aug 20 close above $125 on volume confirms supply cleared. Below $115 on elevated volume signals front-running of remaining tranches.
trade_setups.invalidation: Hot CPI (Aug 12) re-escalating September hike odds above 50% introduces simultaneous rate and supply pressure at $133.

bear_case: A hot July CPI print Wednesday (above 3.2% headline or 3.5% core) re-escalates September hike odds from ~44% toward 65%+ in a single session, pushing the 30Y above 5.20% and turning Friday's record SPX close at 7,757 into an air pocket heading into the Aug 20 SPCX tranche unlock. The more proximate risk is an oil spike before Wednesday: WTI at $78.72 is $0.28 from the $79 trigger and Brent at $84.39 is $0.61 from $85 — Iran's formal decoupling of Hormuz reopening from the Oman deal eliminates the near-term de-escalation scenario, and a single Houthi strike or Iranian escalatory action activates both oil triggers simultaneously (2-of-6 regime). If both oil breach and a hot CPI print in the same 48-hour window, three regime indicators breach simultaneously before NVDA earnings on August 26. If SPX loses 7,600 on a daily close before Wednesday, the hold thesis is not intact.
